theorems.name: Submission.iwl_imc_normalized_lebesgue_points
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ K) < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn f (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ k)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x (R * r), ‖f y - f x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
